scope.includes: Surface opening, shared locations first introduced in these books, visited places and explicitly marked mentioned venues.
scope.exhaustiveness: Evidence-backed working inventory, not an exhaustive concordance of the complete novels.
scope.chronology: Book 1 covers tutorial floors 1–2; Book 2 covers floor 3, the Over City.

evidencePolicy.canonVisualFeatures: Short source-supported observations; confidence is scoped to what was verified, not a canon guarantee.
evidencePolicy.authoredKitPieces: Proposed reusable art modules inferred from place functions; these are not additional canonical places or exact novel floorplans.
evidencePolicy.sourceAccess: Direct publisher samples and DCCDatabase reads preferred. Fandom facts obtained from live indexed extracts where direct access was blocked.
evidencePolicy.automatedSources: Automated/new recap sites used only for labeled low-confidence candidate gaps where no stronger accessible source located.

locations.name: Carl and Bea’s Seattle apartment
canonVisualFeatures: Two-bedroom apartment; second-story window; Donut trophy room.

locations.name: Seattle street and apartment tree
canonVisualFeatures: Tree by apartment window; sidewalk; winter night; post-collapse dirt footprints where structures stood.

locations.name: Surface entrance at former thrift-store site
canonVisualFeatures: Bright warm opening with upward spotlight.

locations.name: Dungeon entrance staircase and landing
canonVisualFeatures: Broad carved wrought-iron descent; marble landing; enormous arched wooden kua-tin double door.

locations.name: Mordecai’s Tutorial Guild Hall
canonVisualFeatures: Fireplace, bed, shelves, photographs, oval gray rug, desk and classroom chairs; Book 2 adds transformation beds.
locations.notes: All guild entrances portal to assigned guide’s personal space; do not invent a separate room for every door.

locations.name: First Floor main arteries and neighborhood alleys
canonVisualFeatures: Rock-hewn grid; broad torchlit arteries; dark red brick and glowing green growth in some side passages.

locations.name: Crawler-specific restroom portal
canonVisualFeatures: Mismatched commercial doors; Carl’s cramped silver-toilet stall; Donut’s litterbox stall.

locations.name: Tally’s Polish restaurant safe room
canonVisualFeatures: Earth fast-food restaurant reused as protected rest space.
locations.notes: Tally’s Polish fast-food restaurant on Floor 1; the play area is a sub-location of this same safe room. Exact chain branding is not established.

locations.name: Sebastian’s Peruvian Taco Bell safe room
canonVisualFeatures: Full kitchen, sleeping area, bathrooms, coffee and Peruvian beer.

locations.name: Alabama Waffle House safe room
canonVisualFeatures: Earth diner used by Meadow Lark survivors.
locations.notes: Described by Brandon; this reference does not establish a Carl visit.

locations.name: DMV waiting-room safe room
canonVisualFeatures: Dingy Earth waiting area repurposed as safe room.

locations.name: Children’s play area in Tally’s safe room
canonVisualFeatures: Earth fast-food interior with children’s play area.
locations.notes: Tally’s Polish fast-food restaurant on Floor 1; the play area is a sub-location of this same safe room. Exact chain branding is not established.

locations.name: Candy-vending rest area
canonVisualFeatures: Small safe rest stop with candy vending.
locations.notes: Described by Brandon; this reference does not establish a Carl visit.

locations.name: Hoarder’s lair / Scatterer nest
canonVisualFeatures: Round high-ceiling room; rubbish mountains and burst black bags; grimy signed door; skull torches.

locations.name: Goblin workshop
canonVisualFeatures: Goblin engineering and explosives workshop.
locations.notes: Industrial kit is an authored translation of workshop function; reviewed Fandom extract supports location and looting, not exact floorplan.

locations.name: Goblin War Chieftain boss room
canonVisualFeatures: Boss room adjoining goblin workshop; includes goblin noncombatants.
locations.notes: Do not turn noncombatant presence into an invented nursery architecture.

locations.name: Juicer’s gym
canonVisualFeatures: High gym ceiling; sliding glass entry; reception turnstile; weights, benches, mats; red combat lighting.

locations.name: Ball of Swine spiral maze
canonVisualFeatures: Rounded tunnels wind around courtyard; portcullises and three gated entrances reached by short bridges.

locations.name: Ball of Swine switch chamber
canonVisualFeatures: Square switching room within spiral route; site of Speedbump construction.
locations.notes: Speedbump is a constructed object, not a canonical terrain material.

locations.name: Revealed Ball of Swine arena and stairwell
canonVisualFeatures: Retracted maze walls reveal domed arena; purple/neon lighting; central illuminated stair with red barrier.

locations.name: Production trailer green room
canonVisualFeatures: Blue velvet couch; shutter-like doors; adjoining recording space and bathroom.

locations.name: Dungeon Crawler After Hours with Odette set
canonVisualFeatures: Talk-show studio appearance; host and audience are holographic projections.
locations.notes: Set layout pieces are adaptation; host/audience are not physically present.

locations.name: Death Watch Extreme Dungeon Mayhem set
canonVisualFeatures: Curved guest table; pig-skull host chair with red velvet; animated monster backdrop; studio audience.

locations.name: Second Floor corridors
canonVisualFeatures: Narrower grid; cracked white concrete floor; magical cinderblock walls; orange-green lichen.

locations.name: French storm-shelter safe room
canonVisualFeatures: Earth storm shelter reused as protected rest space.

locations.name: Big Shot Chicken / Qwist’s safe room
canonVisualFeatures: Fried-chicken safe room with rental rooms, besieged by a Rage Elemental.
locations.notes: Named safe room; decorative architecture and scorch variants remain art adaptations.

locations.name: Rev-Up moonshine distillery / bottling room
canonVisualFeatures: Bolted metal moonshine tub; filled and empty jugs; alchemy table; bicycle-powered blenders.

locations.name: Krakaren Clone boss chamber
canonVisualFeatures: Adjoins distillery; wooden decorative lettering above door; tentacles breach entrance.

locations.name: Kobold dog-pound corridors
canonVisualFeatures: Portuguese municipal pound; three cage-lined hallways; captive Danger Dingoes.

locations.name: Ralph’s kobold fighting arena
canonVisualFeatures: Arena opens beyond pound corridor doors; small reinforced boss cage.

locations.name: Pet reward room / menagerie
canonVisualFeatures: Caged pet choices after Ralph; Donut selects Mongo.

locations.name: Over City arrival and race-selection approach
canonVisualFeatures: Golden brick walls and floor; red carpet; illusory star and nebula ceiling.

locations.name: Over City abandoned urban ruins
canonVisualFeatures: Abandoned city surrounds scattered villages; artificial sky and wooden-plank ground.

locations.name: Over City small guarded villages
canonVisualFeatures: Small populated settlements amid dangerous ruins; shops and guilds.

locations.name: The Belly-Rubbed Pug
canonVisualFeatures: Inn/pub safe room on third floor.
locations.notes: Distinct signage required; exact facade and room plan are authored.

locations.name: Grimaldi’s Traveling Circus grounds
canonVisualFeatures: Three large tents, smaller tents, wagons and cages; low rock/wood/bone battlement.

locations.name: Grimaldi’s World O’ Freaks entrance
canonVisualFeatures: Faded attraction sign and sideshow imagery at tent entrance.

locations.name: Grimaldi’s central ring
canonVisualFeatures: Pale green vine fills center ring and reaches tent ceiling.

locations.name: Signet’s house
canonVisualFeatures: Tall white building near vine, according to chapter index.
locations.notes: Location existence supported by secondary chapter index; inspect novel before asserting detailed architecture.

locations.name: Medium Skyfowl Settlement
canonVisualFeatures: Mostly two-story buildings for flying residents; some ground floors unoccupied.

locations.name: The One-Eyed Narwhal
canonVisualFeatures: Settlement pub/inn safe room.

locations.name: Lucky’s General Goods
canonVisualFeatures: General store in Medium Skyfowl Settlement.

locations.name: Skyfowl general and potion shops
canonVisualFeatures: Multiple general stores and potion stores within settlement.

locations.name: Skyfowl administrative building
canonVisualFeatures: Building lacks first and second floors; upper mall and offices.

locations.name: Administrative building shopping mall
canonVisualFeatures: Third-floor shops oriented toward Skyfowl.

locations.name: Featherfall and Miss Quill’s offices
canonVisualFeatures: Fourth-floor administrative offices.

locations.name: Administrative wreckage and ritual structure
canonVisualFeatures: Ruined building conceals Featherfall’s corpse tied upside down to circular ritual construction.

locations.name: Apito Education Center / 201st militia temple
canonVisualFeatures: Corrupt temple in poorer residential street, two blocks from administrative building.

locations.name: GumGum alley beside Desperado Club
canonVisualFeatures: Alley where party encounters GumGum’s body and Krasue.

locations.name: Swordsmen depot / Remex warehouse
canonVisualFeatures: Warehouse opposite administrative building; guards below, soul apparatus above.
locations.notes: Warehouse supported by chapter index; source calls it Swordsmen Depot. Exact architectural tile placement is authored.

locations.name: Dispenser’s ruined-building hunting site
canonVisualFeatures: Boss camouflages against buildings outside Medium Skyfowl Settlement.
locations.notes: Do not invent a conventional enclosed boss room.

locations.name: Desperado Club exterior and public pub
canonVisualFeatures: Tower evoking 1920s New York; knife logo; town-specific public pub.

locations.name: Desperado Club main nightclub
canonVisualFeatures: Shared nightclub with dance floor and bar; third dungeon floor unlocks club’s first level.

locations.name: Silk Road marketplace
canonVisualFeatures: Mostly empty single row of market booths on third floor.
locations.notes: Wiki infobox incorrectly says first appearance Book 3; its Book 2 story and chapter-16 citation establish earlier visit.

locations.name: Hobgobs and Boom Sticks
canonVisualFeatures: Pustule’s explosive-supplies booth in Silk Road.

locations.name: Bitches and Penis Parade entrances
canonVisualFeatures: Adult entertainment venues on club’s first level; warned against during first visit.
locations.notes: Interior visit is established in Book 3, not Book 2; keep Book 2 coverage to entrance.

locations.name: Club Vanquisher
canonVisualFeatures: Rival membership club available from Over City.
locations.notes: No Book 2 interior detail established; do not reuse later temple details here.

locations.name: Descending stairwells and landings
canonVisualFeatures: Downward stairs connect floors; boss arenas may contain stair openings.

locations.name: Industrial-kitchen safe room
canonVisualFeatures: Converted industrial kitchen with a working walk-in freezer, reached after the elemental escape.
locations.notes: Secondary-source support; exact kitchen floor plan is not available.

coverageGaps.status: Bookworm index lists swimming pool; not corroborated by stronger source in this review. Do not render it as a separate canon location without checking novel.

coverageGaps.status: Book 2 media episode known from chapter indexes; exact physical sets and different trailer identities need dedicated verification.

coverageGaps.status: Club overview aggregates later books. Casino details explicitly sourced to Book 3; parent Book 3 researcher should own first interior coverage.

coverageGaps.status: Boss mentioned in floor source; visited geometry not established. Avoid inventing a canonical airship arena.
